name: Streaming World Loader
description: Seamless paging with an opinion about entities. world.chunk_manager already pages terrain data in and out around the player; this component adds the lifecycle policy terrain alone cannot express — which entities despawn when their chunk unloads, which persist by snapshotting through persistence.save_system, and which scripted set-pieces must never be culled mid-fight. The seam is the product: transitions are prefetched a ring ahead so the player never watches the world blink into existence. It owns entity lifecycle across page boundaries only. It does not mesh chunks (presentation.voxel_mesher), does not grade detail (presentation.lod_system), and does not decide what spawns in a fresh chunk (world.dynamic_encounter_spawner).

inputs.name: prefetchRadius
inputs.description: Rings of chunks beyond the active set kept warm. One ring hides the seam at walking speed; vehicles and sprint builds need two, at real memory cost.

inputs.name: entitySnapshotOnUnload
inputs.description: Whether unloaded entities serialize their state instead of resetting. False is the classic 'the bandit camp fully healed while you were away' bug-as-feature.

inputs.name: neverCullTags
inputs.description: Entity tags exempt from unload culling. A boss that despawns because the player ran away far enough is a cheese strategy, not a memory optimization.

inputs.name: maxEntitiesPerChunk
inputs.description: Cap that forces spawners to budget. Without a cap, a rich chunk pages in a slideshow.

outputs.name: pagedInEntities
outputs.description: Live entity count restored this session.

outputs.name: snapshottedEntities
outputs.description: Entities serialized on unload, for memory telemetry.
